description:
Anti-ransomware protection for Windows with real-time behavioral monitoring

Cyber Prot is a Windows anti-ransomware tool that adds a behavioral protection layer alongside your existing antivirus. It monitors process activity and file changes in real time to help detect and block suspicious encryption attempts before they cause damage. Free for Personal and Small Business use on up to 5 computers. Business and Enterprise use requires contacting Next IT Computers.
Current executable refreshed to version 5.3.1.58.
